bodyJson.description: Slack's answer, as a JSON object; empty when the call may not go yet.

retryAfterS.description:
Set when the call may not go yet (Slack's 429, or the relay's limits):
try it again after as many seconds.

deliveries.description:
Oldest first, leased for a minute: a delivery not acked by then is
claimed again.

feed.description: Channel messages and gaps, oldest first, leased as deliveries are.

installs.description: The link's live installs: any other the local install has is gone.

acked.description: How many of acks were taken.

hostedFeed.description:
Hosted's foundry.slack.feed and follow: a local install's own can only
narrow them.

nextSendAt.description: When the address's next reminder goes.

again.description:
The address already had a schedule running, which this request left as
it was.

rows.description: Rows in its table plus pieces not synced yet (resent ids count again).

bytes.description: Uncompressed bytes of its table plus those of batches not synced yet.

v1EventSourceCapacity.description:
EventSourceCapacity is how full an event source's table is, against the
caps every table has. Output only.

type.description: string, number, boolean, object or array; null while it has only been null.

synced.description: A sync has read it: its pieces are in the source's table.

id.description:
1 to 128 bytes, each 0x21-0x7E; unique per source: a later piece with the
same id replaces it.

dataJson.description: The piece's data: one JSON object, as its exact text.

v1FoundryEventPiece.description: FoundryEventPiece is one piece sent to an event source.

payloadJson.description: The parsed event or click, as the intake keeps it.

v1FoundryRelayDelivery.description:
FoundryRelayDelivery is a request Slack sent a relayed install, which its
local install queues as an intake row of the same id and dedupe key.

v1FoundryRelayFeedGap.description:
FoundryRelayFeedGap is a span of a channel's messages (every channel's,
for channel_id "") a relayed install may never get: its local install
records it as a gap of its feed.

v1FoundryRelayFeedOn.description:
FoundryRelayFeedOn says whether a local workspace's Slack data connector
reads its relayed install (on), and whether its install takes unmentioned
follow-ups (follow): hosted then holds the install's thread replies for
it, with or without a data connector.

kind.description:
The buffer row's kind (message, changed, deleted, replied, channel,
joined, left, span or complete).

v1FoundryRelayFeedRow.description:
FoundryRelayFeedRow is a channel message's buffer row for a relayed
install's Slack data connector, which its local install appends as it is.

installedBySlackUserId.description: Who in Slack installed it: the local owner's own Slack account.

feedOn.description: Hosted holds its channel messages for its local install.

v1FoundryRelayInstall.description:
FoundryRelayInstall is a live install of Helix's Slack app serving one of
the link's local workspaces, which its local install mirrors (no token:
its calls go through the relay).

teamId.description:
The install's team and Grid org ("" outside one), read from the event
as the API reads an event's.

channelId.description:
The channel; "" for every channel the feed reads, when the event named
none the door could read.

minute.description: The minute's start: the event's event_time, else when the door took it.

v1FoundrySlackFeedGap.description: FoundrySlackFeedGap is one minute of one channel's events Slack dropped.

body.description: The body exactly as Slack sent it: the signature is over these bytes.

v1FoundrySlackSignedEvent.description: FoundrySlackSignedEvent is a request to the events URL as Slack signed it.

snapshotJson.description:
The snapshot as package dashboard writes it (dashboard.Snapshot): no
workspace's, ontology's, load's or person's id.

httpStatus.description:
200 for every request taken, or one the bot does nothing with; 400 for
a body Slack doesn't send; 401 for a signature that doesn't verify; 404
wherever foundry.slack is off.

contentType.description: The body's media type; empty with no body.

body.description: url_verification's challenge, as JSON; empty otherwise.

v1ReceiveSlackRequestResponse.description: ReceiveSlackRequestResponse is the HTTP answer the door gives Slack.

signed.description: What became of signed's gap; UNSPECIFIED without one.

token.description: The link's hx_rl_ token: Helix keeps only its SHA-256.

workspaceId.description:
The Helix workspace the install is linked to, and the email of the
member who linked it.

newFields.description: Fields this send added to the source.

warning.description: Set from 80% full: how full the source is and what happens at 100%.

v1SlackRoute.description:
SlackRoute is the door's route a Slack request came to.

 - SLACK_ROUTE_EVENTS: POST /v1/slack/events: the Events API, a JSON body.
 - SLACK_ROUTE_INTERACTIVITY: POST /v1/slack/interactivity: clicks, a form whose payload is JSON.

v1SlackSignedGap.description:
SlackSignedGap is what became of a signed event's gap.

 - SLACK_SIGNED_GAP_RECORDED: Its signature verified, and its gap is recorded (or was already) for
the live feed reading its team.
 - SLACK_SIGNED_GAP_UNREAD: Its signature verified, but no feed reads it: not a channel event, a
channel shared with another organisation, no live install or feed of
its team, or foundry.slack.feed off.
 - SLACK_SIGNED_GAP_UNVERIFIED: Its signature is false, or its timestamp out of the five-minute window:
no gap is recorded.
